summary: Iteration 14 full verification of the SellAuth commercial-launch reconfiguration (backend + frontend). New suite /app/backend/tests/test_sellauth_launch_v6.py = 26/26 passed (catalog id mapping, SellAuth-synced prices, all cart-rule cases, coupon passthrough, removed coupon endpoints, banner auth/validation/persistence, regressions). Full backend suite after test maintenance: 141 passed / 23 skipped / 0 failed. Verified against SellAuth for real: a catalog checkout produced invoice 15230222 with productId 851931 / variantId 1508699 at SellAuth's own price $25.00 (status 'created', LEFT UNPAID); a typed coupon reaches SellAuth and its rejection ('The coupon code is invalid.') is surfaced verbatim in the UI, proving passthrough with no local coupon engine (/api/coupons/validate and /api/admin/coupons are 404). Webhook regression: bad signature 401, good 200 -> order created with sellauth ids, replay deduped; confirmation email rendered 5 https://pokecoins.cc links and delivered (id a0966fff...). Browser: /products lists the 3 PokeCoins first, Event Pass cards show locked-notice + 'Locked' before any companion, unlock after adding 1M Stardust (not just coins), re-lock once a pass is in the cart, cart stepper caps a pass at qty 1, CartDrawer + Checkout show the validation error and disable checkout for a pass-alone cart, banner renders on home/products/checkout/my-orders/admin/payment-success, dismiss persists across navigation, enabled=false hides it everywhere, and admin banner-form save propagated to the public banner. /payment/success on a seeded paid session flipped to 'Payment confirmed' within ~2s and unlocked order-chat + claim-account-card. ONE LAUNCH BLOCKER FOUND: /checkout crashed with 'payable is not defined' (blank page) for every user until I applied the one-token test-unblocking fix.

minor.issue: Order total/subtotal are written from OUR list prices and discount is hardcoded 0.0, but SellAuth is now authoritative for price and coupons. If a buyer uses a real SellAuth coupon (or SellAuth prices drift from ours), the stored order total and the 'Total paid: $X' line in the confirmation email are wrong. The webhook should reconcile the paid invoice total (sellauth.get_invoice) back onto the order before emailing.

allow_origin_regex='.*' together with allow_credentials=True and httpOnly cookies set with SameSite=None means any website can issue credentialed requests to the API (CSRF surface on admin endpoints). Playbook expects explicit origins.

Dead code after the coupon engine removal: Coupon, CouponIn and CouponValidateRequest models are still defined (CouponValidateRequest even forward-references CartItemIn). Delete them so nobody wires them back in.

ui_bugs.issue: LAUNCH BLOCKER (reproduced then unblocked by me): the pay button rendered `Pay ${money(payable)}` but `payable` is defined nowhere in the file -> ReferenceError 'payable is not defined' on mount, so /checkout rendered a completely blank page (dev overlay in preview, white screen in prod). Nobody could check out. I changed it to money(total) to continue testing - PLEASE CONFIRM that the intended amount is the cart total (SellAuth applies the coupon on its own page) and keep a lint/CI gate (no-undef) so this class of crash cannot ship again.

A locked Event Pass 'Locked' button has no disabled/aria-disabled attribute - it is fully clickable and only blocked inside add() with a toast. Spec asked for a disabled add. Screen-reader/keyboard users get no hint that it is inert.

The banner form renders with empty inputs and then GET /settings/banner overwrites local state on arrival (and re-fires on every switch back to the settings tab). Reproduced: text typed before the fetch resolved was silently reverted to the server value while the link-label typed after it saved - the admin saved a half-edited banner. Add a loading state / only hydrate once when the form is untouched.

integration_issues.issue: The 2s poll is correct, but ANY failed request (transient 5xx/network blip) sets state='pending' and stops polling forever - a paying customer can land on 'Payment still settling' even though the webhook confirms seconds later. Retry a few times before giving up and show an error state.

AnnouncementBanner fetches only on mount, so a banner change needs a full reload (the admin toast even says 'reload any page to see it'), and the internal link is a raw <a href='/products'> which forces a full page reload instead of SPA navigation. Use <Link> for internal paths.

issues: The featured toggle is an icon-only star with no text/aria-label, so its state is not announced and is unreadable to automation (state had to be verified through the API).

action_items: CONFIRM the Checkout.jsx pay-button amount (I replaced the undefined `payable` with `total`) and add an eslint no-undef/CI gate - this bug made /checkout a blank page for every visitor.
Reconcile the SellAuth invoice total (and any SellAuth coupon discount) back onto the order in the webhook so order totals and the confirmation email are not our list prices.
Lock CORS down to explicit origins (credentials + SameSite=None cookies with allow_origin_regex='.*' is a CSRF surface).
Make the admin banner form hydrate once / show a loading state so typed edits are not overwritten by the GET.
Let PaymentSuccess retry after a failed poll instead of dropping straight to the 'pending' end state.
Delete the leftover Coupon/CouponIn/CouponValidateRequest models; use <Link> for the internal banner link.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx referenced an undeclared identifier in JSX - only reachable at render time, so nothing caught it. Any file touching money should be lint-gated.

server.py checkout(): 'subtotal' is computed from our prices purely for bookkeeping while SellAuth prices/coupons decide the real charge; either stop storing a total we do not own or reconcile it on the webhook.
server.py is 939 lines and still mixes auth, orders, messaging, banner settings and analytics - split by domain routers.

Product create/update/delete endpoints are still live (admin-only) even though the Products tab is display-only; that is fine, but the Coming Soon toggle uses the generic PUT /products/{id}, so a future field added to ProductUpdate is one typo away from being mass-edited from the UI. Consider a dedicated PATCH /products/{id}/coming-soon like the featured toggle.
AnnouncementBanner has no error state; a failed GET silently hides the banner site-wide.

rca_of_the_issue: Checkout crash: pages/Checkout.jsx line 147 interpolated `money(payable)` while the component only defines `total` (from useCart) - a leftover identifier from the removed local discount engine. Because it is evaluated during render, the whole Checkout tree threw ReferenceError and React unmounted it, producing a blank /checkout for every user (verified in the browser: 'PAGEERROR: payable is not defined', checkout-page node count 0). Replacing it with `total` restored the page and the full guest flow then worked end to end (sync popup to https://pokecoinss.mysellauth.com/checkout/..., session stored, redirect to /payment/success). Banner half-save: Admin.jsx re-runs api.get('/settings/banner') in a useEffect keyed on the active tab and unconditionally setBanner(data), so any edit made before the response lands is overwritten.
